Chhattisgarh High Court dismisses plea against school prayer directive

The Chhattisgarh High Court has dismissed a petition challenging a directive for students to recite the Saraswati Vandana and Gayatri Mantra in state-run schools. The court stated that the order is not coercive and that the prayers are intended as moral instruction rather than religious practice. The directive was upheld, with the court ruling that it falls under the category of moral education.
